title: Cartoon Network Flash Games
summary: The Web Design Museum preserves and exhibits classic Cartoon Network Flash games from the early 2000s, documenting an important era of browser-based gaming and web culture before Adobe Flash was deprecated.
problem_solved: Preserves and makes accessible retro Flash games that would otherwise be lost due to Flash's deprecation.
why_valuable: Provides historical preservation of 2000s web gaming culture and interactive web design heritage for future generations.
